title: Telescope frame triage before stacking

provenance.origin: Written for the AstaUI prototype; not a real participant's work.

notes: The 48 frames are drawn in the page from a fixed seed: one star field with dither, changing seeing and sky, and planted problems (two satellite trails, four cloudy frames, three trailed frames, two with a hot column, a stretch of bad seeing). FWHM, background and star counts come from the generator's parameters, not from measuring the pixels. Decisions live only in the open tab until exported.
